customManagers.description: Bump the pinned Flutter SDK in GitHub Actions workflows. Renovate has no native parser for subosito/flutter-action's `flutter-version:` input, so this regex manager points it at the flutter-version datasource (the Flutter SDK release list).

packageRules.description: Every workflow's Flutter pin moves in one PR, which never auto-merges. A Flutter release changes the prebuilt native libraries Google Play checks for 16 KB page alignment, and it can force new transitive package majors (analyzer 12 -> 14 under 3.50), so the PR is read and the local SDK is upgraded to match before merging.
